description: Links from curated catalogue products to records in the CEOS MIM database (CEOS Database API IDs). Maintained by hand; tools/build_mim_snapshot.mjs reads this file. mission_ids limits the missions shown to those the curated product covers. constellation_ids adds MIM constellation records where a product comes from a commercial constellation.

links.note: MIM records the satellites as the HiVE Constellation; the curated record names SkyBee A01 and A02.
MIM records DESIS as its own mission, DESIS-on-ISS.
MIM lists EnMAP Surface Reflectance (assessed) and Aquatic Reflectance (in development) separately; this curated record is the Surface Reflectance product.
The MIM instrument record also lists RISAT-1 and RISAT-1B; this product uses RISAT-1A (EOS-04) only.

Limited to Sentinel-2A and 2B, as in the curated record; the MIM instrument record also lists Sentinel-2C and 2D.
MIM records the first StriX-α and StriX-β demonstrators as missions (both complete); the operating satellites are the StriX constellation.
